_: Mureren in English: Brickie (a bricklayer laying dominoes like bricks). «Mur» is a wall (one puzzle); «felt» a coloured region with a rule. Use «spots» for the dots on a domino.
{brikke} ligger på {sted}. Trykk for å t: {brikke} is on {sted}. Tap to pick it up.
{brikke}, chosen. Tap again to turn it.
Choose a domino at the bottom first.
Det er ikke plass til brikka bortover he: There's no room for the domino lying flat here. Tap Turn to stand it on end.
Det er ikke plass til brikka på høykant: There's no room for the domino on end here. Tap Turn to lay it flat.
Alle brikkene ligger, men noen regler st: Every domino is down, but some rules don't fit yet.
Brikker som lå feil, er tatt opp, og én: Dominoes in the wrong place have been picked up, and one is laid right.
One domino has been laid right for you.
Legg alle dominobrikkene på brettet, sli: Lay every domino on the board so that each coloured region keeps its rule.
Trykk på en brikke nederst, og så på en: Tap a domino at the bottom, then a square. Tap the domino again, or Turn, to turn it.
Et tall er summen av øynene i feltet. =: A number is the total of the spots in the region. = means they're all the same, ≠ that they're all different. <4 and >9 mean the total is under 4 or over 9.
Alle brikkene skal brukes, og hele brett: Every domino must be used and the whole board covered. Squares with no colour have no rule.
Begynn med de små feltene: en rute med 0: Start with the small regions: a square that must be 0 or 6 tells you a lot.
En dobbel brikke (to like) passer godt i: A double (two the same) fits nicely in an = region.
Trykk på en brikke som ligger på brettet: Tap a domino on the board to pick it up again.
Regelen blir grønn når feltet er fullt o: The rule turns green when the region is full and fits, and red when it can't work.
Hvert brett har bare én løsning. Hint ta: Every board has only one solution. A hint picks up dominoes in the wrong place and lays one right.
Med tastatur: piltastene flytter mellom: With a keyboard: the arrow keys move between squares, 1–9 choose a domino, R turns it, Enter lays it, H gives a hint and P pauses.
Hver mur er ny og har bare én løsning –: Every wall is new and has only one solution – you never need to guess.
The wall is waiting for you.
Every domino is on the board.
You built today's wall in {tid} the first time.
Alle i hele landet får den samme muren i: Everyone in the country gets the same wall today.
Uten hint! Alle i hele landet får den sa: No hints! Everyone in the country gets the same wall today.
Første mur på {niva} – nå har du en reko: Your first wall on {niva} – now you've got a record to beat!
